description.narrative: The 2X Ignite Africa GP Sprint is an acceleration programme designed to boost the fundraising journey of fund managers. This is a 6-month programme focused on supporting 11 women-led or gender-balanced fund managers with gender-smart investing strategies to better position themselves for a successful fundraising journey with their investment vehicles. The GP Sprint is designed in a very hands-on and practical way to accelerate the GPs in real time on their fundraising journey to a first or subsequent close. Participants commit time, perseverance, openness to feedback, and positive energy to work closely with the 2X Ignite team and a selected group of Strategic Advisors to implement priority actions.
